description: This Java class, ProductImagesController, manages CRUD operations related to product images within an admin web interface, including listing, saving, and deleting images for products in an e-commerce system.

classes.name: ProductImagesController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller managing product image operations in the admin section, including listing, uploading, and deleting images.

methods.name: displayProductImages
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the product images management page for a specific product.

methods.name: pageProductImages
methods.description: Handles POST requests to fetch a paginated list of product images in JSON format.

methods.name: saveProductImages
methods.description: Handles POST requests to upload and save new images for a specific product.

methods.name: deleteImage
methods.description: Handles POST requests to delete a specific product image.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets menu states in the model for navigation purposes.
